customerOutcome: Explicitly review and approve temporary support access through the original V6 owner, and resolve the original pending request without duplicate grants.
entryConditions: Current authenticated Native company owner and matching expected account/company.
Original effective admin_support_v6 gate for review, approval and receipt reads. Cancellation of an ungranted original request remains available to its current Native owner after gate rollback.
exitConditions: Navigate away; a prepared original request is retained by the Native owner and recovered on a current account/company read.
Current source loss hides form, review, pending reference and history.

content.supportingCopy: Review the configured operator, reason, exact scopes and maximum duration before explicitly approving temporary access. Historical receipt metadata is separate from current operator authority.
displayedState: Current original Native support records and at most one unresolved original review for the current owner.
An unresolved original review prevents preparing a replacement. No private form, review or record is shown while the current source is checking or refused.
Recorded approval is not current authority, successful support work or a reversed previous action.

inputs.validation: One currently configured independent operator; 1–200 characters.
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: No restored private browser values; current component input only.

inputs.validation: 10–500 characters; immutable in the original reviewed request.
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: No restored private browser values; current component input only.

inputs.validation: Status read plus explicitly selected runtime management or backup restoration; never a new permission catalog.
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: No restored private browser values; current component input only.

primary.label: Review temporary access
primary.operation: Freeze one original UUID and input; reserve only its content hash with the original Native owner, then show that exact review. This step grants no support access.

secondary: Approve temporary access only after review and explicit acknowledgement
Cancel the original ungranted request; a committed grant is reported rather than silently revoked
Read the exact original approval after an unclear response
Revoke an exact original Native session and recover its original timestamp
Retry the same original review reservation or cancellation after an unclear response
destructiveOrIrreversible: Explicit approval grants the reviewed original V6 scopes for the bounded duration; Native use independently rechecks owner, configured operator, scope, expiry and revocation.
Original request cancellation fences later approval of that same reference; already-recorded access requires its separate explicit Revoke action.

canonicalReadDomains: Original Native V6 support_sessions, active owner membership, instance rollout and existing activity_log review/approval/cancellation receipts
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original Native V6 support owner prepareApproval/approve/cancelApproval/revoke; no new grant owner, scheduler, browser persistence or permission engine.
systemWork.authorityEffect: The original owner/configured independent-operator predicate is unchanged. Review reservation has no access effect; cancellation affects only the original ungranted command; grant use remains separately admitted.
systemWork.asyncWork: Five-second SQL statement bound and Native privacy/owner/rollout/original-reference locks. Foreground fifteen-second current source refresh, Native events and focus hide old private data during checking.
systemWork.receipt: Existing Native review hash and original support-session UUID. Exactly linked approval audit is required for receipt reconciliation; expiry/revocation is never renewed by replay.

states.loading: Current checking hides all private inputs, review, pending reference and history.
states.empty: Current Native source reports no unresolved review and no support records; this does not infer the outcome of an unrelated or unrecorded command.
states.partial: Source is implemented for Native DB-local review/approval/cancellation/revocation; exact Native, built browser, human, hosted and general support recovery acceptance remain pending.
states.stale: Withdraw private state and reread current Native authority; do not display a stale pending reference as a grant.
states.validation_error: Current Native input/ref/hash mismatch refuses an effect. Preserve an unconfirmed original request rather than substituting a new reference.
states.system_error: Fixed localized errors; raw Native errors are omitted. The original request remains blocked until exact reconciliation/cancellation.
states.permission_denied: Hide private state and refuse Native commands; receipt metadata cannot substitute for current owner or operator authority.
states.recovering: On navigation/reload, read the current owner's original unresolved Native review. Check its exact receipt or explicitly cancel that same command before preparing new access. A missing receipt is not no effect.
states.success: Original approval recorded or original ungranted command cancelled. These facts do not prove current scoped authority, support work or reversal.

navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: An unconfirmed command retains the original Native reference/hash. Ordinary leave does not grant access or automatically cancel. Explicit cancellation is Native, idempotent and targets only the original command.
navigation.resume: Current owner/account/company reads recover an unresolved original review without local storage, restored private fields or automatic effect replay.

accessibility.initialFocus: Current H1 on entry; user-requested review moves focus to its H2 while preserving an already open Native dialog.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Fixed source-error alert receives focus; current-source refresh restores its previous control or heading and preserves an open Native dialog. Actual DOM tests pass; built browser/manual AT acceptance remains pending.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Current source is reread and prior control/heading focus is restored. Actual DOM restoration tests pass; built browser and human acceptance remain pending.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Semantic labelled form and review, unchecked acknowledgement, Native buttons with min-h-11 touch targets.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Polite loading status, safe alert for unavailable current state.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Stacked current state and receipt rows at narrow width; no horizontal table.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Native Layout owns the sole main landmark; this page uses a section, semantic headings, lists, named scope labels and time elements. Source errors receive focus.

responsive.wide: Stacked wrapping metadata, token touch targets and no horizontal table.
responsive.narrow: Stacked wrapping metadata, token touch targets and no horizontal table.
responsive.mobile: Stacked wrapping metadata, token touch targets and no horizontal table.

dataShown: Current original owner-only operator, reason, scopes and times; pending reference and reviewed time only.
dataCollected: Existing original support approval fields; Native review/cancellation audit stores only a content hash and existing scoped identities.
sensitiveFields: Private reason/operator/review fields are not copied to a second journal, browser storage, mailto, analytics, diagnostics or HTTP logs.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Whole original support namespace including malformed and rejected operations has fixed content-free logging. Successful original support responses are private/no-store.

functional: Native lost post-commit ACK, exact immutable request replay, concurrent approval/cancellation, stale request fencing, expiry/revocation retention and no duplicate audits.
Native reserve/reload/replacement refusal, exact Native owner/company/flag/independent-operator checks and missing/ambiguous original receipts.
accessibility: Actual DOM review/acknowledgement/focus and same-tick guards; exact built mobile axe, complete keyboard/error/focus recovery and manual AT remain pending. Forty selected actual Native support/SaaS/operator cases pass, including durable review/replay/cancellation and scoped owner refusal.
securityPrivacy: Strict content-free pending DTO, private current source withdrawal, no browser persistence or automatic effect retry.
Original Native operator use authority remains unchanged and independent of UI receipts.
usability: Representative formal support approval/cancellation/revocation and unknown-outcome journeys on the accepted artifact remain pending.
